phases.name: spawn-late-game-gear
phases.lua:
local function printf(format,...) log1(string.format(format,...)) end
local a=db.actor; assert(level.name()=="jupiter"); local p=a:position(); local d=a:direction(); d:mul(3); p:add(d); p.y=p.y+1; _G.shader_sweep_gear={}; for _,s in ipairs({"wpn_gauss","wpn_g36","wpn_rpg7","detector_elite"}) do local o=alife():create(s,p,a:level_vertex_id(),a:game_vertex_id()); assert(o); _G.shader_sweep_gear[s]=o.id; p.x=p.x+0.7 end; printf("SHADER_SWEEP GEAR scheduled=4 map=%s",level.name())

phases.name: confirm-visuals-and-play-effects
phases.lua:
local function printf(format,...) log1(string.format(format,...)) end
local n=0; for s,id in pairs(_G.shader_sweep_gear) do local o=level.object_by_id(id); assert(o and o:get_visual_name()); printf("SHADER_SWEEP MODEL %s %s",s,o:get_visual_name()); n=n+1 end; assert(n==4)
local a=db.actor; local p=a:position(); local d=a:direction(); d:mul(4); p:add(d); p.y=p.y+1; _G.shader_sweep_particles={}; for _,name in ipairs({[[anomaly2\effects\bloodsucker_invisibility]],[[weapons\effects\gauss_shot_sparks]],[[artefact\effects\af_electra_idle_color]]}) do local fx=particles_object(name); fx:play_at_pos(p); _G.shader_sweep_particles[name]=fx; printf("SHADER_SWEEP EFFECT %s active=%s",name,tostring(fx:playing())) end

phases.name: night-thunder
phases.lua:
level.change_game_time(0, (23 - level.get_time_hours()) % 24, 0)
local function printf(format,...) log1(string.format(format,...)) end
level.set_weather("default_thunder",true); printf("SHADER_SWEEP WEATHER map=%s cycle=%s hour=%d",level.name(),level.get_weather(),level.get_time_hours())
